topic: Your brain's best guess 6: Small kindnesses go further than you think
caption:
Small kindnesses go further than you think.

The prediction: a small kindness is too small to matter.

In experiments, people doing a small kind act underestimated how much it lifted the other person’s mood. Givers focus on the size of the act. Receivers focus on the warmth behind it.

Something to try: maybe offer one small, unexpected kindness to someone nearby.

Your brain's best guess is our series on everyday predictions that research suggests are often too pessimistic. Studies were with US participants and measured mood straight afterwards, so results may differ for you.

Research: Kumar, A., & Epley, N. (2023). A little good goes an unexpectedly long way: Underestimating the positive impact of kindness on recipients. Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, 152(1), 236-252. https://doi.org/10.1037/xge0001271
